mission.description: Accounting-only fixture that exercises startup, loaded operation, and shutdown while storage first charges and then discharges.

boundary.input_definition: Synthetic external energy crossing into the entire conversion-system boundary.
boundary.useful_output_definition: Synthetic useful energy delivered outside the registered boundary after internal auxiliaries are accounted for separately.

candidate.description: Hand-authored values constructed only to test schema shape and exact first-law bookkeeping.

solver.method: hand-authored accounting fixture; no physical solver

uncertainty.method: Placeholder values demonstrate manifest structure only; no uncertainty propagation has been performed.
assumptions: Uncertainty values are synthetic placeholders, not derived from instruments or calibrated models.
Correlation is unknown. This fixture must not be used to claim a confidence interval or superiority.

data_provenance.description: Hand-authored numbers satisfying the intended accounting identity; not measured, published, or simulated physical-system data.
Synthetic placeholder used only to test calibration-reference integrity; not calibrated evidence.

limitations: This is a schema and bookkeeping fixture, not an engine or generator model.
The example efficiency is arithmetic over invented values and has no physical or comparative evidentiary value.

A verifier must independently check interval continuity, interval ordering and uniqueness, required phase presence, first-law closure for each interval and aggregate totals, stored-energy closure, and consistency of the cached computed metrics.
An uncertainty-aware superiority claim requires a declared propagation method and correlation treatment, plus comparable baseline evidence.

evaluation_policy.differential_bias_bound_basis: Synthetic fixture only; not evidence that real systematic bias is zero.
evaluation_policy.selection_rule: No decision permitted: fixture exists only to validate schema and verifier behavior.
